scope: Prepared optional metadata for the two implemented 3D-only adapters. A30 shared flow/content/validation support remains separate: current validation requires scene and dataKey, while assigning the 3D scene as its own 2D fallback would loop on a WebGL loading failure. Browser tests use an explicitly declared descriptor/content fixture. No default or runtime registry change.
